new_bars.name: Kwãnt Mayfair
new_bars.bio: Erik Lorincz, the former head bartender of the American Bar at The Savoy, first opened Kwãnt off Regent Street in 2019 and relaunched it in 2023 on a Mayfair corner by Green Park. The room leans tropical, with cane, palms and ceiling fans, and the drinks lean on ferments and unusual distillates, served by bartenders working stations around the counter. No. 79 on The World's 50 Best Bars 2025.
new_bars.why: Erik Lorincz's bar; No. 52 (2024) and No. 79 (2025) on The World's 50 Best Bars 51-100, No. 40 on Europe's 50 Best Bars 2026.

new_bars.name: Three Sheets Soho
new_bars.bio: Brothers Max and Noel Venning took the Three Sheets formula from their original Dalston bar to a Manette Street site in Soho in 2024. Menus are short and built on pared-back, seasonal twists on modern classics, with a carbonated French 75 as the calling card, plus oysters and a proper burger from the kitchen. No. 73 on The World's 50 Best Bars 2026 (51-100).
new_bars.why: Venning brothers' Soho bar; No. 80 (2025) and No. 73 (2026) on The World's 50 Best Bars 51-100, No. 41 on Europe's 50 Best Bars 2026.

new_bars.name: A Bar with Shapes for a Name
new_bars.bio: Remy Savage and Paul Lougrat opened this Kingsland Road bar in May 2021, naming it with a yellow triangle, red square and blue circle. The whole concept borrows from the Bauhaus: a spare, functional room and short menus where each drink is designed around a single lead flavour, with classics on request. No. 73 on The World's 50 Best Bars 2025 (51-100).
new_bars.why: Bauhaus-themed bar from Remy Savage; No. 61 (2024) and No. 73 (2025) on The World's 50 Best Bars 51-100.

new_bars.name: Waltz
new_bars.bio: Tokyo-born bartender Gento Torigata, formerly of Kwãnt, opened Waltz in spring 2025 behind a discreet door on Scrutton Street. About a dozen seats face a long elm counter, jazz plays through custom speakers, and the Japanese-style menu splits into evergreen signatures and drinks that shift with Japan's 72 micro-seasons. No. 23 on Europe's 50 Best Bars 2026.
new_bars.why: 2025 opening; No. 23 and Best New Opening on Europe's 50 Best Bars 2026, Japanese listening-bar concept.

new_bars.name: Side Hustle
new_bars.bio: The cocktail bar of NoMad London, opened in 2021 inside the former Bow Street police station and magistrates' court in Covent Garden. Around a marble-topped bar and green leather booths, it pairs a Latin American-leaning, agave-focused cocktail list with tacos and snacks. Best International Hotel Bar at the 2025 Spirited Awards.
new_bars.why: Agave-focused hotel bar; Best International Hotel Bar, Tales of the Cocktail Spirited Awards 2025.

new_bars.name: American Bar
new_bars.bio: The Savoy's American Bar opened in 1893 and the hotel calls it London's original cocktail bar. Harry Craddock and Ada Coleman both worked here, and Coleman's Hanky Panky was born at The Savoy. Today's menu tells stories from the hotel's history alongside vintage spirits and classics. It was No. 1 on The World's 50 Best Bars 2017 and the Spirited Awards' World's Best Bar 2018.
new_bars.why: Historic London hotel bar (1893); World's 50 Best Bars No. 1 in 2017 and Spirited Awards World's Best Bar 2018.

new_bars.name: Lyaness
new_bars.bio: Ryan Chetiyawardana (Mr Lyan) opened Lyaness in March 2019 at Sea Containers London on the South Bank, in the room that had housed his Dandelyan. The menu is organised around house-made ingredients rather than classic templates, built through ferments and collaborations, and served over Dandelyan's original green marble bar. World's Best Bar at the 2022 Spirited Awards.
new_bars.why: Mr Lyan's flagship and a London innovation benchmark; Spirited Awards World's Best Bar 2022.

new_bars.name: Café Pacifico
new_bars.bio: A Covent Garden Mexican restaurant and tequila bar, open since 1982, that calls itself London's oldest and says it was the first to bring Mexican food and tequila to the UK. Margaritas are the core of the list, alongside a long agave selection and mezcal drinks, and its bartenders have repeatedly won London's Margarita Rumble. Timeless International Award at the 2024 Spirited Awards.
new_bars.why: London's pioneering tequila bar (1982); Timeless International Award, Tales of the Cocktail Spirited Awards 2024.

new_bars.name: Swift Soho
new_bars.bio: Mia Johansson and Bobby Hiddleston opened Swift on Old Compton Street in November 2016, the first of three Swift bars. Upstairs is a walk-in room for quick aperitivo-style drinks; the booked basement pours more involved cocktails, hosts live jazz and holds a whisky list of more than 300 bottles. Its Irish Coffee has become one of the city's signature serves.
new_bars.why: Soho stalwart approaching its 10th anniversary, famous Irish Coffee and whisky list; long a fixture of best-bar lists.

drinks.name: Connaught Martini
drinks.description: Gin or vodka with dry vermouth, mixed tableside from the martini trolley and finished with the guest's pick of the bar's aromatic bitters.

drinks.name: Low Tide
drinks.description: A reversed Manhattan: rye whiskey with Amaro Nonino and walnut-infused white port, sharpened with coriander bitters.

drinks.name: Afterglow
drinks.description: Johnnie Walker Blue Label with long pepper-infused sweet vermouth, a yuzu and cherry sherbet and a measure of Suze.

drinks.name: Satan's Manhattan
drinks.description: A by-the-book Manhattan whose ingredients are frozen ahead of serving, giving a colder, denser and silkier drink.

drinks.name: Miami Vice
drinks.description: Strawberry daiquiri and piña colada poured side by side in one glass so the two halves stay separate, served with an umbrella.

drinks.name: 4.50 From Paddington
drinks.description: A gin and tonic twist named for Agatha Christie: Fords gin with chinotto honey and acqua di cedro, lengthened with tonic.

drinks.name: Whodunnit
drinks.description: Rémy Martin 1738 cognac shaken with a tart blackberry and kumquat aperitif, the bar's take on a sidecar.

drinks.name: Iron Lady
drinks.description: Glenfiddich 12 whisky with chocolate wine and fig leaf, balanced with clarified citrus.

drinks.name: See the Sea
drinks.description: A savoury martini of gin, langoustine distillate, fino sherry and Cocchi Americano with a few drops of sea oil.

drinks.name: Green Park Margarita
drinks.description: Tequila shaken with blended avocado and yuzu plus ayuuk, a Danish spirit made from beer malt and smoked chilli.

drinks.name: French 75
drinks.description: Bombay Premier Cru gin, clarified lemon, orange flower water, Picpoul wine, tea, oak and verjus, carbonated and served sparkling.

drinks.name: Dirty Martini
drinks.description: Belvedere vodka with Koseret tea, olive oil, Picpoul and sea salt, with an optional caviar bump.

drinks.name: Strawberry Boulevardier
drinks.description: Hennessy VS with fermented strawberry, a bitter aperitivo, Earl Grey tea and Pineau des Charentes.

drinks.name: Core
drinks.description: El Gobernador pisco with ruby cacao and kalamata olive, served short.

drinks.name: Toreador
drinks.description: Ocho tequila with Greensand apricot eau de vie, the bar's recomposed lime and agave.

drinks.name: Atlas
drinks.description: Redbreast 12 Irish whiskey and Amarás espadín mezcal with dulce de leche and tonka.

drinks.name: Matcha Old Fashioned
drinks.description: Hibiki Harmony whisky stirred with Yame matcha and honey, one of the bar's standing signatures.

drinks.name: Wakayama
drinks.description: Suntory Chita whisky stirred with baijiu, ripe banana and umeshu plum liqueur.

drinks.name: Cherry Blossom
drinks.description: A clean, crisp mix of sake, sherry, cherry blossom liqueur and shochu.

drinks.name: Sergeant Pepper
drinks.description: Abelha cachaça and Altos Blanco tequila with green pepper, coriander, jalapeño, pineapple and lemon.

drinks.name: Toreador
drinks.description: Don Fulano Fuerte and Tapatío Reposado tequilas with apricot, génépi, lime and agave.

drinks.name: Hanky Panky
drinks.description: Gin and sweet vermouth with a dash of Fernet-Branca, created at The Savoy by head bartender Ada 'Coley' Coleman.

drinks.name: Since 1986
drinks.description: White port and blanco rum, a tribute to Savoy doorman Tony Cortegaca and his Portuguese roots.

drinks.name: Painter's Palette
drinks.description: Rabbit Hole Boxergrail rye, Khoosh bitter and Viña AB amontillado sherry, a nod to Monet's stays at the hotel.

drinks.name: Red Carpet
drinks.description: Whisky with 30&40 Double Jus, Amaro Lucano, honey and cold-brew coffee, inspired by Dior's 1950 Savoy show.

drinks.name: Pink Belly Gimlet
drinks.description: Hendrick's gin with carrot salami, aquavit honey and lemon; also offered alcohol-free.

drinks.name: Chet² Martini
drinks.description: Belvedere vodka and vermouth given body by direct-sourced fermented cacao from BiBi chocolate.

drinks.name: Rapaport Cocktail
drinks.description: A Martinez-style sipper of Fords gin, tree caramel and a sequentially fermented vermouth with VORS sherry.

drinks.name: Pacifico Margarita
drinks.description: Ocho Blanco tequila, agave nectar and fresh lime, on the rocks or up in a salt-rimmed glass; also sold by the bottle.

drinks.name: Pomelon Margarita
drinks.description: Jose Cuervo Tradicional reposado with watermelon, mint, lime, pomegranate, orange liqueur and house citrus bitters.

drinks.name: Bru-groni
drinks.description: Bruxo espadín-barril mezcal with Campari, Karminia vermouth and Cynar, finished with smoked rosemary.

drinks.name: Irish Coffee
drinks.description: Jameson Caskmates Stout Edition with a Send coffee blend made for Swift, demerara, a float of cream and nutmeg.

drinks.name: Imperial Gimlet
drinks.description: Beefeater gin, Italicus, white Pineau des Charentes, pineapple sherbet, makrut lime and lemon.

drinks.name: Little Venice
drinks.description: Hendrick's gin, Pommeau, peach vermouth and Campari, stirred bitter and floral.

notes: Tayēr + Elementary (existing handle tayer_elementary) is excluded: it has been closed since a May 2026 fire, and in September 2026 the owners said it will stay shut for the rest of 2026 (https://www.restaurantonline.co.uk/Article/2026/09/17/we-miss-you-tayer-elementary-duo-dash-hopes-of-reopening-this-year/). A summer 2026 pop-up (Casual by Tayēr at Cato, Covent Garden) has ended.

The World's 50 Best Bars 2026 top 50 is announced on 7 October 2026 (after this research); only the 2026 51-100 list is included. Satan's Whiskers and Connaught Bar are absent from 51-100 so may place in the top 50.
the50.com is the current domain of theworlds50best.com (301 redirect); award source URLs point there.
Connaught Bar 2012 and 2016 Spirited Awards 'World's Best Cocktail Bar' wins are sourced from Difford's Guide's winners list, not an official Tales page.
Scarfes Bar's own site claims 'No. 1 Best International Hotel Bar, Tales of the Cocktail 2024', but the official 2024 winners list gives that award to BKK Social Club (Bangkok); not included.
Kwãnt Mayfair has no working website (kwant.co.uk is a parked 'coming soon' page), so website is its Instagram. Its OSM node shows postcode W1J 8LR; the bar and 50 Best use W1J 8LN.
Three Sheets' Instagram @threesheetsbars covers both Dalston and Soho; handle threesheetssoho is a variant for the Soho bar that is ranked.

A Bar with Shapes for a Name: Instagram @a_bar_with_shapes_for_a_name_ ends in an underscore, so handle is abarwithshapesforaname. Drinks come from the 'sample menu' PDF linked from clubbauhaus.com (file named 'shapes neue menu 12-09'); the year of that menu is not stated.
Swift's Instagram @swiftbars covers three sites; handle swiftsoho is a variant. American Bar has no separate Instagram (hotel account @thesavoylondon), so handle americanbarsavoy is a variant.
Side Hustle: thenomadhotel.com no longer resolves; website is NoMad London's Hilton page. Its drinks are from a bar guide (top50cocktailbars.com), not a current menu, so on_current_menu is false.

The 50 Best lists the Haggerston bar with a shapes emoji prefix (🔶🟥🔵); name here uses the plain words. Kwãnt appears as Kwãnt on the 50 Best lists and as Kwānt on 50 Best Discovery; the bar has no website to confirm.
Waltz changes much of its menu with Japan's micro-seasons; drinks are from 2025-2026 press, not a live menu, so on_current_menu is false.
Hanky Panky ingredients (gin, sweet vermouth, Fernet-Branca) are the standard published spec; the source confirms the 1903 Savoy origin and that it is still served, but not today's exact menu.
Near misses: Artesian (The Langham; No. 1 on the World's 50 Best Bars 2012-2015) and Amaro (No. 90, 2024) were left out for variety; Artesian is a strong alternative.
